- **en first-load ceiling (#32225):** reason keys live in the lazy Studio namespace catalogues (`namespaces/studio/en.ts` +557 B, `zh.ts`); `locales/en.ts` +0 B. No zh-Hans edit, so no zh-Hant regeneration owed.
- **Deviations accepted:** (1) five commits (one per card, a `check:test-source-alias` import commit, the main merge), history not rewritten. (2) Keys in the Studio namespace packs, above. (3) `@object-ui/i18n` patched too (published catalogues changed). (4) Seven older `ResourceEditPage` suites now find Save by `resource-save` and read the reason from the description; every assertion kept. That is the #32105 fix itself (name stays "Save"). (5) Stable element tree, above. (6) The whole-package app-shell run was stopped after about an hour with only the 4 fixed files flagged; the rest is not measured locally and is owned by remote `Test UI`. Landing waits for it.
- **Gates:** `/mnt/project-files/card-32103/gates-e1fe6667.txt` (37/37 derived families, sdui-manifest, spec-symbols, new-line-citations, commit-card-trailers; app-shell and i18n type-check exit 0).

Neither touches this diff. The seat re-runs the failed jobs once through the relay; a second failure is treated as real.
- **Contract faces:** none of the four, so CI plus this seat read is the review of record. Changeset prose checked against the diff.
